label: Test degree adequacy and strictness on a populated sole-giver interpretation (inference)
rule: Evaluate two degree assignments on the same fixed two-bearer causal profile
meaning: A constant degree satisfies total-cause adequacy and gives the distinct giver and recipient equal degrees. On the same efficient total edge the assignment giver 1, recipient 2 violates adequacy. This tests formal entailment without treating unconstrained degree assignments as metaphysical counterexamples.
